display_name: Snapdeal formula pattern — GST on Product Sales
formula_sql: SELECT CASE WHEN tax_igst_amount <> 0 THEN 'IGST' WHEN tax_cgst_amount <> 0 OR tax_sgst_amount <> 0 THEN 'CGST_SGST' ELSE 'NO_GST_OR_UNKNOWN' END AS gst_type, SUM(total_tax) AS product_gst, SUM(charged_amount_excluding_tax) AS taxable_value FROM zs_observe.snapdeal_oms WHERE is_active = true AND transaction_type = 'forward' GROUP BY 1
